screens.title: Owner sign-in
screens.note: Controlled provisioning; no public registration.

screens.title: My work / first visit
screens.note: After sign-in; no sample tasks are inserted.

screens.title: Create project
screens.note: Prefix: 2–10 uppercase letters/digits; starts with a letter; unique.

screens.title: Project overview
screens.note: Progress excludes canceled / archived leaves; overview owns its own note.

screens.title: Create section
screens.note: Invalid nesting explains the depth limit and leaves the form intact.

screens.title: Section / direct tasks
screens.note: Direct tasks by default; subtree inclusion is explicit and shareable.

screens.title: Section / plan
screens.note: Lifecycle changes are explicit; completing tasks does not complete a section.

screens.title: Edit project
screens.note: Archive is a separate labeled action in the project menu.

screens.title: My work
screens.note: Non-overlapping groups: overdue first, then status. Blocked work stays visible.

screens.title: All tasks / list
screens.note: Filters and view selection remain in URL state; sorting does not rewrite ranks.

screens.title: All tasks / board
screens.note: Column order follows workflow. Drag changes status; menu alternative remains available.

screens.title: Task detail / side panel
screens.note: Desktop ≥1440 inline; 1024–1439 overlay. Back restores the list state.

screens.title: Task / full page
screens.note: Open full page for long notes and stable deep links. Activity and integrations continue below.

screens.title: Create task
screens.note: Optional properties: due date, labels, description, parent task. C opens outside editors.

screens.title: Task / links, files and activity
screens.note: An integration outage preserves local task content and shows cached freshness.

screens.title: Move / organize task
screens.note: Move carries subtasks; cannot move between projects or add a third task level.

screens.title: Global search
screens.note: Title, description, note text, reference and labels; no attachment-content search.

screens.title: Filters and sort
screens.note: Ready to work = Ready with no manual or dependency blocker.

screens.title: Search / no results
screens.note: Empty results retain query and current filter context.

screens.title: Note history / preview
screens.note: Project, section and task notes share the same history pattern.

screens.title: Attachments / transfer states
screens.note: Attachments belong to project / section / task; notes link only ready files.

screens.title: Note editor / long document
screens.note: Formatting stays within the supported structured note schema.

screens.title: Settings / general
screens.note: Light and dark share the same hierarchy; explicit theme override persists.

screens.title: Project workflow
screens.note: Custom labels map to canonical categories used by browser and MCP.

screens.title: Project labels
screens.note: Label names max 40 characters; search includes label names.

screens.title: Repositories and PR rules
screens.note: Read-only GitHub App. Rules never mark Done or regress task status.

screens.title: Import GitHub issue
screens.note: Copies title and body once; provenance and per-project deduplication survive unlinking.

screens.title: Agent credentials
screens.note: Secrets are shown once; revoke cuts access. No OAuth MCP discovery in V1.

screens.title: Create agent credential
screens.note: Next: show secret once with Copy and explicit storage instruction.

screens.title: Credential / shown once
screens.note: Wireframe contains no real secret. Creation must verify explicit grants.

screens.title: Integration health and exports
screens.note: Exports are owner-only. Restore operations require tested operational recovery.

screens.title: Complete parent task
screens.note: Keep parent open is the cancel choice. Transition remaining nonterminal subtasks atomically.

screens.title: Reopen completed sections
screens.note: No work is added until all affected completed ancestors are explicitly reopened.

screens.title: Archive work
screens.note: Archive is reversible. It leaves statuses, notes and dependency links intact.

screens.title: Permanently delete archived work
screens.note: Remove external dependencies first; owner only. Backup retention can last 30 days.

screens.title: Archived work / restore
screens.note: Archive state is independent from status and section lifecycle.

screens.title: Note conflict / compare
screens.note: Applies to autosave conflicts and recovered drafts; retain attempted edits on failure.

screens.title: Task controls / dependency validation
screens.note: Manual and computed blocking are independent. Canceled / archived prerequisites need resolution.

screens.title: Sign out / draft recovery
screens.note: Never silently replace a newer server note with a recovered draft.
